endpoint: _algovault (MCP tool response envelope metadata block) — auth state

_meta.supersede_reason: ONE snapshot per shape. The knowledge-bundle builder projects every audits/*-shape-snapshot-*.json into response_shapes under its `endpoint` string, so two live files describing _algovault would publish contradictory contracts under one doc id.
_meta.rule_cite: CLAUDE.md Build rules: 'Allow-list not deny-list for public-API response shaping' + 'Public-shape snapshot with drift-check for every NEW or modified public endpoint'

added: auth — {outcome, presented, tier}. STRICTLY ADDITIVE: removing the key from a rendered meta yields the pre-wave block byte-identically. Emitted at ALL SEVEN live tools via withAuthState(), including the three hand-built envelopes in scan-trade-calls.ts and the fail-soft one in scan-funding-arb.ts, so no tool is a straggler.
changed_this_wave.unchanged: Every pre-wave key keeps its name, type and semantics. `quota` is untouched; `auth` is the field that makes reading a quota number to infer auth state unnecessary.

quota_shape.total: number (the tier's monthly allowance; free = 100, FROZEN)
quota_shape.resets_at: ISO-8601 instant. The window is ROLLING 30 days anchored on the caller's FIRST call — NOT a calendar month, so it cannot be reconstructed as 'the 1st of next month'.
quota_shape.omitted_when: unmetered tiers (x402 / internal — their quota is Infinity and has no honest JSON form), bot-internal traffic, or a non-finite/non-positive limit (default-deny)
quota_shape.key_names: used/total/remaining deliberately match scan_trade_calls' long-shipped _algovault.quota rather than inventing a second vocabulary for the same fact.

envelope_shape.message: string — the ONE exhaustion notice (usage N/limit, reset date, ranked paths)
envelope_shape.retry_after_days: number — DERIVED from resets_at, never passed separately
envelope_shape.suggested_action: string — the structured-error law's suggested_<action> (added this wave)
envelope_shape.suggested_x402: OPTIONAL — present only when a LIVE public x402 rail was derived

TIER_LIMIT_REACHED.fires_when: a free-tier caller invokes a metered tool at or above the cap (license.ts checkQuota returns allowed:false)
TIER_LIMIT_REACHED.frozen_behaviour: At the cap ALL calls stop — trade calls AND HOLDs. get_trade_call gates at ENTRY, above any market work, so the tool cannot know whether the call would have been a HOLD; that is what makes a HOLD pass-through structurally impossible rather than merely absent. Regression-locked by tests/unit/quota-exhaustion-notice.test.ts 'AC2'.
TIER_LIMIT_REACHED.no_teaser: The notice never hints that an actionable verdict existed — no verdict, no confidence, no partial result.
TIER_LIMIT_REACHED.interaction_with_tier_warning: tier_warning is NEVER set on this error path; the envelope carries the full context itself.

envelope_shape.message: string — the same notice contract, chat wording

CHAT_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.fires_when: the SEPARATE monthly chat meter is exhausted (free = 10/mo). Served by POST /api/chat (HTTP 429) and the chat_knowledge MCP tool (isError:true) from ONE builder so they cannot drift.
CHAT_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.reset_semantics: UTC CALENDAR-month boundary — deliberately DIFFERENT from the call meter's rolling 30-day window. Each notice states its own.
CHAT_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.code_unchanged: Deliberately still CHAT_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, not TIER_LIMIT_REACHED: the two meters are independent events and exhausting chat leaves the trading tools working.
CHAT_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.no_referral_arm: Referral bonuses credit the CALL meter, so offering them on a chat wall would promise relief that never arrives.
CHAT_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.changed_this_wave: upgrade_url moved from https://algovault.com/#pricing (a different destination from every other surface, carrying no upgrade_from) to the attributed /signup URL — every chat-wall click was previously invisible to the funnel.

cache_contract.quota_freshness: computed per-request from the in-process callTrackers meter (license.ts); no caching layer between trackCall() and emission
cache_contract.stale_signal_handling: n/a — the counter only increments in-process and is write-through persisted to quota_usage; a restart re-hydrates it via initQuotaDb

consumers: MCP client (Claude Desktop / Claude Code / Cursor / Cline) — tight: read _algovault.quota.remaining + resets_at to show headroom, and tier_warning.suggested_upgrade_url as a CTA. Absence of either field is normal (paid/unmetered/bot-internal) and must be a no-op.

LLM agent (system prompt readers) — loose: branch on the stable TIER_LIMIT_REACHED / CHAT_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED codes and on suggested_action. Do NOT block tool invocation on tier_warning or quota; only the explicit error envelope blocks.
Telegram bot (BOT-W1) — documented-only: bot-internal calls bypass BOTH tier_warning and quota; the bot meters its own users in SQLite.
ops/monitoring/quota-exhaustion-canary.py — documented-only: reads the quota_usage table directly, NOT this envelope, and pages only on HIGH-VOLUME exhaustion.
drift_check_command: curl -fsS https://api.algovault.com/mcp -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"get_trade_call","arguments":{"coin":"BTC","timeframe":"15m"}}}' | sed -n 's/^data: //p' | jq -r '.result.content[0].text' | jq -r '._algovault | keys | sort | join(",")' | { read keys; for allowed in 'auth,compatible_with,exchange,quota,session_id,tier_warning,tool,venue_status,version' 'auth,compatible_with,exchange,quota,session_id,tool,venue_status,version' 'auth,compatible_with,exchange,session_id,tool,venue_status,version'; do [ "$keys" = "$allowed" ] && { echo 'DRIFT_CHECK_OK'; exit 0; }; done; echo "DRIFT_CHECK_FAIL: got '$keys'"; exit 1; }
drift_check_notes: The response is an SSE event-stream, so the `data:` prefix must be stripped before jq — a naive `jq` on the raw body fails with a control-character error.
quota is present for any METERED caller (free or paid) and OMITTED for x402/internal/bot-internal — the check accepts both.
tier_warning is present only from 80% of the cap — the check accepts both.
upgrade_hint fires only for free tier on a non-HOLD verdict; a HOLD response omits it.
auth is present on EVERY served response — it is the one member with no omission condition, which is what lets a caller branch on it unconditionally.

A refused credential (UNKNOWN/INDETERMINATE) returns a JSON-RPC error with NO result, so this command's jq would find no envelope at all — that is the refusal working, not drift. Probe it with `Authorization: Bearer av_live_<24 zeros>` and expect error code -32003.
test_coverage: tests/unit/algovault-meta-tier-warning.test.ts (tier_warning: thresholds, paid tiers, bot-internal, immutability, defensive NaN/zero/negative) + tests/unit/quota-exhaustion-notice.test.ts (the notice per surface, quota additivity proven by byte-comparison, and the frozen cutoff regression-locked against HOLD and non-HOLD) + tests/auth-refusal-mcp.test.ts (refusal codes, method scope, kill switch, consumes-nothing, and 7/7 auth coverage across every live tool)

auth_shape.outcome: 'ABSENT' | 'MALFORMED' | 'UNKNOWN' | 'INDETERMINATE' | 'RESOLVED' — the SAME vocabulary the resolver decided with (single derivation, src/lib/credential-outcome.ts). Normally one of the three SERVED values; the two refusing ones appear only under AUTH_STRICT_UNKNOWN=0, where an UNKNOWN key is served and the honest thing to report is UNKNOWN.
auth_shape.presented: boolean — whether a credential was presented at all. `presented:true` with `tier:'free'` is the whole diagnosis for an unexpanded ${env:AV_API_KEY}.
auth_shape.tier: the tier actually served, so a caller can compare it against the one they pay for
auth_shape.omitted_when: never on a served response. A REFUSED call (UNKNOWN / INDETERMINATE with the strict switch on) returns a JSON-RPC error and has no envelope at all.
auth_shape.why_it_exists: A well-formed but non-existent key was served the free tier with HTTP 200 and no signal, so the only support advice available was 'read _algovault.quota.total, and if it says 200 your key did not work' — inferring auth state from a QUOTA number, which correlates today and would stop correlating the moment the free allowance changed.
auth_shape.never_contains: no key material, no customer id, no upstream/billing detail.
